DeterminationBasis: The contemplated effect is part of the governing state needed before consequential action; T01-001 directly tests governing-state completeness before consequence.
The requirement explicitly separates authority from technical capability; T03-003 directly falsifies treatment of capability as execution authority.
Authority scope must be bounded; T03-001 directly establishes authority validity within declared scope.
Execution authority must be current rather than inferred from history; T10-001 directly performs execution-time revalidation against current state.
Internal LILP conformance cannot establish external validation; T16-003 directly rejects unsupported stronger external-status claims.
T16-004 prevents inflation when the requested proof level is not established, while T16-001 keeps the surviving claim bounded to the property actually supported by evidence.
Existing T16 cases address bounded claims and missing evidence but do not directly test that an actual mandatory FAIL blocks profile PASS.
A profile PASS cannot exceed evaluated scope; T16-001 directly requires claims to remain bounded to established evidence and scope.
T14-005 directly preserves the failed predecessor, corrected successor and explicit lineage between them.
Existing T13 cases preserve failure history but do not directly test that failure of a mandatory falsification test prevents PASS for a dependent conformance profile.
A test PASS is a material claim; where observed behaviour does not satisfy the declared expected result, T16-001 prevents PASS from outrunning the evidence.
Credential or signing-key loss or compromise is a material changed condition; T10-002 directly invalidates stale permission and requires reassessment after material delta.
A known deviation is not necessarily a tested FAIL; existing T13 failure-preservation cases therefore do not directly establish that every known mandatory-requirement deviation is recorded.
T14-002 requires a material correction basis and successor evidence, directly supporting preservation of the reason for material successor change.

T14-002 distinguishes material successor change but does not test the required classification of whether a post-freeze correction changes normative meaning, guidance, metadata, presentation or the frozen object itself.
T05-001 establishes admissibility and provenance but does not test sufficiency of the evidence referenced by a PASS matrix entry relative to the PASS determination.
T13-001 directly requires a valid FAIL and its associated failure record to remain explicitly represented and identifiable.
Existing T14 successor cases preserve predecessor states but do not perform a destination collision attempt and require freeze tooling to refuse overwrite of an existing freeze artifact or receipt.
